## About Me

I'm a student at the University of Denver's Daniels College of Business, earning a B.S. in Business Information & Analytics with a minor in Finance (expected June 2027). I'm also enrolled in a Real Estate master's program. My work sits where three fields meet: **data, finance, and real estate**. I like taking a messy spreadsheet or a raw dataset and turning it into an answer someone can act on.
